comments.body:
Quest name: Luxurious Grave
Quest location: Cape Town Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Recognition, r17 Archaeology, CHN(Chinese)
Pre-requisite discovery: Imperial Seal discovery (from "Someday, I'll Return" quest) + The Great Wall discovery (from "North China Building Investigation" quest)
Pre-requisite action: Archaeologist's Growth 1 skill must be activated in order to see the quest
Additional note: "Branch-off" part of Xanadu questchain
